name: Kenneth R. Yegan
office: Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Six

items.text: Kenneth R. Yegan is an associate justice of the California Court of Appeal, Second Appellate District, Division Six, serving since 1990. Before that, he served on the Ventura County Superior and Municipal Courts and as a Ventura County deputy public defender. In 2026 he dissented in a coastal pipeline case, saying the Coastal Commission should not override county permitting authority. He has also written criminal, tax, and insurance opinions.
